مدير تحميلات يدعم HTTP و HLS و DASH والفيديو والتورنت

description.p: Ezoo Download is a desktop download manager written in Rust. It splits files over up to 32 connections, resumes after interruptions, and keeps running next to the clock when its window is closed.
Ezoo Download مدير تحميلات مكتوب بلغة Rust: يقسّم الملف على عدة اتصالات، يستأنف بعد الانقطاع، ويبقى بجوار الساعة عند إغلاق النافذة.

Ezoo Download was created by Ahmed Ezzat (Ezoo Tech). This Flatpak is built from the fork at https://github.com/kerlif/ezoo-download, based on the upstream project at https://github.com/AhmedEzo686/ezoo-download; all author credits are kept. The Flatpak uses the runtime's codec libraries, fetches yt-dlp itself on first use, and keeps the browser-extension bridge on the local loopback exactly as the other Linux packages do.

ul.li: Multi-connection downloads with resume (HTTP/HTTPS, FTP via aria2)
HLS (.m3u8) and DASH (.mpd) video streams with AES-128 support
Video and audio from the browser via its extension
Torrents and magnets (aria2), YouTube via yt-dlp
System tray icon, queue, scheduler, speed limits, grabber
Eight languages with an Arabic-first interface

description.p: Fork release: adaptive multi-connection download engine, bundled Carlito, Noto Sans Arabic and Liberation Serif fonts, update checker against the fork's releases, Flatpak packaging, and the fix for dialogs rendering side by side on Wayland.
First Linux release: .deb and AppImage packaging, system tray for KDE/GNOME/XFCE, embedded Arabic and Latin fonts, and DASH (.mpd) stream downloads.
